reviews.title: Helping me communicate better!
reviews.pros: I find WhatsApp to be a great and exciting platform to communicate with other users with an ease. Besides instant messaging, WhatsApp also allows me to create group, join communities, share multimedia files, share statuses, make and take both voice and video calls.
reviews.cons: WhatsApp is a good platform for all my instant communication needs and I have not came across any issues while using it.
reviews.overall: I had a great experience using WhatsApp for my personal and professional communication needs. WhatsApp has a feature rich UI and is easy to understand even for the new users. WhatsApp has changed the way I communicated with my team and clients. It has also been helpful in customer support and lead generation.

reviews.title: Excellent and easy to use app.
reviews.pros:
- It only takes your phone number and that's it. It doesn't ask any other details of the user to use this app.

- It is very user-friendly and easy to use app with no ads and completely free to use.

- User can delete the scent message which is a good feature that WhatsApp offers to the users.

- it has brilliant audio and video calling features, which uses fewer data than its competitors.
reviews.cons:
- The data is stored in the servers, which is a security concern and is not full proof.

- you cannot send a video file bigger than 61mb and a document having size bigger than 100 MB, which is one of the biggest cons of WhatsApp.

- WhatsApp group accommodates fewer number of people whereas its competitors like telegram accommodates 1000x more people.
reviews.overall: WhatsApp is a great app and very easy to use. For me, it has more advantages than disadvantages, and it is my go-to  messaging app.

reviews.title: A good website
reviews.pros: I am very interested in this project so far . it has been very useful for communication and also granting high quality videos.
reviews.cons: Sometimes during conversation or video calls the connection get interrupted but I think the is from the internet provider not the application.
reviews.overall: My experience with WhatsApp has been very great. I have been WhatsApp for so many years ago and it has been a great honour to have the contact of everyone I know.

reviews.title: A widely used messaging application.
reviews.pros:
- WhatsApp is the most widely use application that gives you a platform to connect with your contacts.

- All the chats on this platform are 128 bit end-to-end encrypted that gives the utmost security to its user privacy.

- All the chats can be easily backed up on local storage as well as on google drive. It gives the user the flexibility to restore chats on a new device.
reviews.cons: The chats on WhatsApp are end to end encrypted, however, the backup datastore on google drive is not, So, the WhatsApp user data can be easily hacked if the google account gets hacked.
reviews.overall: Overall, WhatsApp is a globally accepted messaging application that can be easily used by people of any age group. It comes with a smooth and easy-to-use user-friendly interface.

reviews.title: One app that changed the face of communication
reviews.pros:
The app registers you using your phone number so you don't have to remember PIN or tags. It shows all your WhatsApp contacts at one place. 

The new status option lets you share moments and it turned the app into a mini social media hub. 

It also has a desktop client so you can use it without your phone. 

No ads 

Free for life
reviews.cons: Doesn't have a report button to report fake news and texts. It's needed in countries like India where fake news is rampantly spread.
reviews.overall: It's a must have app as it includes video/VoIP and instant messaging under one roof. Above all it's a free app and has no ads, which is great.

reviews.title: What good is an end-to-end encrypted chat app if you can't use it
reviews.pros: I was pretty hyped about WhatsApp because it offers end-to-end encryption, and many of my friends highly recommended it. It also has a sidebar extension in Opera Developer Browser on laptops/desktops, so I thought it would be convenient to use.
reviews.cons: Upon signing up with my phone number, which I've had for years, and never used WhatsApp before, I ended up getting an account disabled message as soon as I sent my first message to a friend. I contacted support and they got back after a day, but it happened again. This repeated three times and by that time I basically didn't care for the app anymore.
reviews.overall: My experience was very bad and very short on account of its unusability. I get why it needs phone number verification, but why is my number getting banned when it's never been used for WhatsApp before, and I completed all verification steps?

reviews.title: Whatsapp - The new way of communication
reviews.pros:
(+) Easy to understand and use.

(+) Great UI and UX

(+) Varied themes and background settings.

(+) Ability to share different file formats

(+) 128 bit secured encryption communication.
reviews.cons:
(-) Not able to send multiple pictures and photos or files at once.

(-) Backup can be background thing.

(-) Sometimes the app crashes and takes time to restore.
reviews.overall:
I am using WhatsApp almost since its inception in India, I have also signed up for the beta testing program and they like to test a lot of new features and constantly upgrade. Whatsapp always gives great competition to its competitors and tries to launch and add all the features possible.

Sometimes Whatsapp can be a mess as the messages are encoded on a 128-bit level which can be used for negative purposes and these calls and messages cannot be tracked or traced because of its level on encryption

reviews.title: The best there is in the business
reviews.pros:
1) Not required to login. Initial registration of Mobile number and name and that's it! You are online.

2) Good encryption set between chats.

3) Update frequency is usually 1 month.
reviews.cons: 1) Updates do not indicate the exact feature. It is usually "Bugs and improvement fixes"

reviews.title: One of the best messaging apps
reviews.pros:
- It allows us to delete a wrongly sent message which is a life saver.

- Auto download can be tweaked in the settings so as to save data.

- One can backup their chats and media automatically in an interval defined by the user.
reviews.cons:
- A forwarded media occupies double the space on the device. It is saved in both the sent and received folder.

- Dark mode is not available. 

- WhatsApp stickers does not have a lot of variety. Third party apps are the only hope there.
reviews.overall: I use this almost all day to chat with my friends, sharing funny stuff and stickers. I also use it to interact with formal groups to work out some serious stuff as well.

reviews.title: Great Alternative
reviews.pros: I love that you can use this app to contact anyone who has it, for free, regardless of where they live in the world.
reviews.cons: This is trivial, but I didn't like how it was automatically downloading pictures texted to my phone - I was running out of storage and didn't realize why.
reviews.overall: I think it's a great way to keep in touch with people you otherwise may not be able to text or call.

reviews.title: The world is on it and its for free!
reviews.pros:
- The dark mode feature is really helpful for the eyes. 

-  The design and ease of use are simply superb. It is quite easy to set up and running even for those who are not very good at tech. This is where it beats other platforms like Telegram.
reviews.cons:
- Still supports only 4 people in a video chat. 

-  The WhatsApp web feature still requires both the devices to be online and connect while apps like Telegram have a much better implementation of these features.

- The update policy is really annoying. I should be able to use the app even without forcible upgrades.
reviews.overall: WhatsApp has changed the way how we use instant messaging for the better. It definitely has a long way to go in dealing with fake news and mass forwards which is going to be particularly difficult given the end-to-end encryption.

reviews.title: Quick conversation starter
reviews.pros: I have tried many other applications but no one came close to WhatsApp in terms of simple user interface and ability to get the conversation going.  The video call feature works great and helps to talk with remote people.  Groups can be easily created for discussions.
reviews.cons: The application can have option to have more group members similar to the telegram.  The WhatsApp web does not work If the Internet connection is not strong.
reviews.overall: Hands down the best chat application I have ever used. Just download it If you haven't already.  More features from the slack application can be added to make it more powerful.
